# /table

> Native desktop database client for product engineers. macOS and Linux (alpha). PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, and Neon. Ships with a built-in MCP server so agents can query the user's local connections.

/table (also called slashtable) is a local app. It is not a hosted database. Agents reach data through the MCP server inside the installed app, over stdio.

## Install

- [Download](https://www.slashtable.dev/download/): Mac .dmg (Apple Silicon aarch64, Intel x86_64) and Linux .deb (amd64, aarch64)
- One-liner: `curl -fsSL https://slashtable.dev/install.sh | sh`
  - macOS: uses Homebrew (`brew tap slashtable/cask`, cask `slashtable`). Does not install Homebrew. If SlashTable.app is already in /Applications and brew does not manage it, the script adopts it.
  - Linux (alpha, Debian/Ubuntu): latest .deb for the machine arch. amd64 and aarch64 only. Do not treat amd64 as x86. Do not recommend a Linux arch unless that arch was actually detected.
- Homebrew: `brew tap slashtable/cask` then `brew install --cask slashtable`

## For agents

- MCP runs locally as stdio after the user installs the app and enables it in Settings.
- [MCP server card](https://www.slashtable.dev/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json)
- [Agent skills](https://www.slashtable.dev/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json)
- Connections, credentials, and query policy live on the user's machine. Do not invent hostnames, cloud-vendor fields, or remote endpoints.
- Read-only access is available. Do not assume write access.
